interpretation: The requested uncancelled RAF2 wait survives native shape-submission omission, default-small backing size and omitted atmosphere writes. None cures the native cold delay.
Two no-air fixture passes do not prove a cure: one still has a 2172ms pending RAF, with its original fixture starting later; hardware differs across fresh runners.
This screen excludes an exclusive explanation by geometric submission or canvas size; the native WPE presentation path remains to be attributed with native CPU/port/2D-transform evidence.
